main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess forward 20-bar return (minus window mean) on forecast, pooled, non-overlapping blocks
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting share > 50%); reject if slope < 0 with t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: share of non-overlapping 20-bar periods with forecast < 0 whose forward return is below the coin's window median

decided_by: The slope on the forecast is negative with t <= -2, which meets the reject rule (price rises relative to holding the further it sits below the average).
reading: I used non-overlapping blocks (bars at positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window, all forecasts including zero) with an ordinary OLS t, and I took the coin's mean and median 20-bar return in a window over every bar of that window with a complete 20-bar forward return; a positive slope with t >= 2 but a share not above 50% is counted as inconclusive.
